summary: Fang Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing the finalization of a derivative lawsuit settlement. The New York State Supreme Court approved a Stipulation of Settlement on February 9, 2026, which became final on March 12, 2026. A special cash distribution will be paid on June 16, 2026, to ordinary shareholders and ADS holders of record as of April 20, 2026, from a settlement account funded by defendants. The filing is a routine update on a legal settlement and does not constitute a special situation event like an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. No deal terms, premium, or board recommendation are involved.
